negative_condition: A scan cancelled by daemon graceful shutdown must not persist inventory rows, must not enqueue recovery work, and must not trigger a startup recovery scan on next daemon start.

mutated_contract.violation: Shutdown-cancelled scan persists inventory rows or enqueues startup recovery work.

assertion: Shutdown cancellation is a first-class cancellation source. The response returns status=cancelled with error_code=cancelled. All permits are released before shutdown completes. No inventory rows are written. No recovery work is enqueued. Daemon startup performs no inventory recovery scan.
